workflow.title: Weekly design team rundown to manager
workflow.goal: Read the tracker, tally finished, open and blocked work items, and email Priya (priya.n@kestrel-labs.io) a short rundown of what the design team finished.

assumptions: The tracker sheet holds the current week's work items; it has no dates, so every row is treated as this week's.
The tracker has no team field, so all tracker items are included and the owner is shown next to each one.
The email is sent only after a person approves it, since outbox.send asks before every dispatch.
risks: Non-design items in the tracker could appear in the rundown if the tracker is shared with other teams.
Rows without a valid status would fail the status check and stop the run.
successCriteria: The tracker is read and its items are tallied.
The rundown lists the finished items with their counts.
The email is delivered to priya.n@kestrel-labs.io and the independent outbox audit passes.

nodes.description: Read every row of the tracker sheet.
Keep only title, status and owner for each tracker row.
Count done, open and blocked items and list the finished ones.
Write the short rundown text from the tally.

args.text:
Hi Priya,

Here is what the design team finished this week.

Done: {{done}} of {{total}} tracked items (open: {{open}}, blocked: {{blocked}}).

Finished:
{{doneLines}}

Thanks

nodes.description: Send the rundown to Priya. Asks a person before dispatch.
Independently re-read the outbox and confirm the rundown reached Priya unchanged.

outbox.subject: Design team weekly rundown
outbox.body:
Hi Priya,

Here is what the design team finished this week.

Done: 3 of 6 tracked items (open: 2, blocked: 1).

Finished:
- Redesign onboarding screens (Ivy)
- Icon set v2 (Omar)
- Pricing page mockups (Ivy)

Thanks

checks.exact: the delivered of “Send the rundown to Priya. Asks a person before dispatch.” equals true

checks.plain: The rundown lists the finished items with their counts.
checks.exact: the pass of “Independently re-read the outbox and confirm the rundown reached Priya unchanged.” equals true

checks.plain: The email is delivered to priya.n@kestrel-labs.io and the independent outbox audit passes.
checks.exact: the total of “Count done, open and blocked items and list the finished ones.” is at least 1

checks.plain: Independently re-read the outbox and confirm the rundown reached Priya unchanged.
